Delhi High Court rules NSE a public authority under RTI Act

The Delhi High Court has ruled that the National Stock Exchange (NSE) is a public authority under the Right to Information (RTI) Act. The court stated that entities owned, controlled, or substantially financed by the government qualify for this designation. This decision clarifies the scope of transparency laws concerning significant financial institutions.
